what: A full photo panel changes every 4.5s with a 1.1s wipe (cubic-bezier(.6,.08,.02,.99)). The wipe direction rotates per section: left, up, left, down. The image inside the outgoing panel slides 50% the opposite way while scaling to 1.2×, and the image inside the incoming panel follows in from −50% and settles from 1.14→1 over 9.4s (4.5+1.1+3.8) power2.out. The progress bar fills 0→1 linearly over one slide, retreats to the right over 1s at the change, and the slide number rolls upward over 1s.

options.settle: Seconds added to the sinking length — sink = every + dur + settle, default 3.8
options.zoom: Initial scale of the incoming image, default 1.14
options.out: Scale the outgoing image grows to, default 1.2
options.turns: Wipe direction order (x·up·down separated by spaces), default "x up x down"
options.wait: When play, holds still until fx:play arrives (starts after the loader)
options.[data-fx-part=img]: Image that moves the opposite way inside the panel (the panel’s first child if none)
options.[data-fx-part=zoom]: Element that receives the sinking scale (img if none)
options.[data-fx-part=count]: Section number — two children (current · next) roll upward to change (optional)
options.fx:pause · fx:play · fx:go: Event sent to the element — pause, resume,{ detail: { index } } To that section. fx:slide on every change { index, prev } brings up

use: …

from.where: index.html .hb-kv (original topWorks: 6 slides at 4500ms, CustomEase slideshow-wipe .6,.08,.02,.99 over 1.1s, transitionCount%4 gives x · y up · x · y down, inner 50% pushed the opposite way, 1.14→1 power2.out 9.4s, progress bar 4.5s linear)
